articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a larger effective context window. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap between AI assistants and domain experts in several fields.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra set new records on SWE-Bench Verified and real-world software engineering tasks, completing multi-file refactors and bug fixes with over 60% autonomous success rates. The model introduces improved tool-use orchestration and a refined chain-of-thought protocol that lets it plan, execute, and self-verify code changes across large repositories.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Begins Limited Deployment in Third-Party Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its Optimus Gen-3 humanoid robots have started operating in select third-party logistics warehouses beyond Tesla's own factories, performing bin-picking, palletizing, and inventory scanning tasks. The rollout marks the first commercial deployment of Optimus outside Tesla's vertically integrated operations and signals a push toward robotics-as-a-service revenue.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C, Demonstrates Conversational Task Planning on Factory Floor
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a massive Series C round valuing the company at over $15 billion, driven by demos showing its Figure 02 humanoid robot interpreting natural-language instructions to autonomously sequence multi-step assembly operations. The system pairs a vision-language-action model with real-time force feedback, enabling it to adapt to part variations without reprogramming.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Orchestration Framework for Enterprise Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new orchestration layer for Claude that enables enterprises to build multi-step agentic workflows with structured guardrails, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. The framework is designed to address reliability and compliance concerns that have slowed enterprise adoption of autonomous AI agents in regulated industries such as finance and healthcare.

articles.title: ASML Reports Record EUV Orders as Chip Firms Race to Build AI Fab Capacity
articles.summary: ASML reported its highest quarterly EUV lithography system bookings ever, driven by orders from TSMC, Samsung, and Intel as all three race to expand advanced-node capacity for AI accelerator production. The surge underscores how AI demand is reshaping semiconductor capital expenditure cycles and tightening the supply of cutting-edge fab equipment through 2028.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture at 288B Active Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released the full weights of Llama 4 Behemoth, a mixture-of-experts model with 288 billion active parameters and over 1.5 trillion total parameters, under a permissive license. Early benchmarks show it competing with leading proprietary models on reasoning and multilingual tasks, and its open availability is expected to accelerate fine-tuning and on-premises deployment across the research community.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: Neuralink obtained FDA clearance to begin human trials of its N2 implant, which doubles the electrode count of its first-generation device and adds bidirectional stimulation capabilities. The approval opens the door to studies exploring not just motor-intent decoding for paralysis patients but also sensory feedback, potentially enabling rudimentary touch sensation through the neural interface.
